problems.explain: 90 sin 27° ≈ 40.86 and 90 cos 27° ≈ 80.19. y = 0 when 16t² − 40.86t − 2 = 0. By the quadratic formula, the positive root is t = (40.86 + √(40.86² + 64 × 2))/32 ≈ 2.6018. So it is 2.6 s.
